title: Our Workout
author: Shaun E.
desc: Transform your physique with the 4-Day Lean Muscle Programme, designed for those looking to build strength while shedding excess fat. Over the course of one week, you'll engage in a balanced mix of resistance training and high-intensity workouts, targeting all major muscle groups for optimal growth and definition. This program is perfect for intermediate lifters seeking to elevate their fitness game with a structured, results-driven approach. Get ready to push your limits and achieve a leaner, stronger you!
